card.line: Ophrah was the hometown of Gideon, where God called him to save Israel from Midian, but the name also belongs to a city in Benjamin.

moments.title: The angel calls Gideon
moments.text: The angel of the LORD sat under the oak in Ophrah, where Gideon was beating wheat in a winepress, a pit where grapes were crushed, to hide it from the Midianites. The LORD told him to go in his strength and save Israel.

moments.title: The altar called The LORD Is Peace
moments.text: The LORD told Gideon not to be afraid, for he would not die. Gideon built an altar there and called it The LORD Is Peace, and it still stood in Ophrah when this was written.

moments.title: Gideon's ephod
moments.text: Gideon made an ephod, a special priest's garment, from the gold and placed it in Ophrah, his hometown. All Israel worshiped it there, and it became a trap for Gideon and his household.

moments.title: Gideon is buried
moments.text: Gideon died at a ripe old age. He was buried in the tomb of his father Joash in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.

moments.title: Abimelech kills his brothers
moments.text: Abimelech went to his father's house in Ophrah and murdered his seventy brothers on one stone. Jotham, the youngest, survived because he hid himself.
